run_translation_finetune: run translation fine-tuning on a sequence-to-sequence model with HuggingFace transformers
create_translation_dataset: create a translation dataset from JSON or JSONL files with source and target language columns
compute_bleu_metric: compute BLEU score metrics for translation evaluation using sacrebleu
preprocess_translation_data: preprocess translation data by tokenizing source and target texts with padding and truncation
generate_translation_predictions: generate translation predictions from a fine-tuned seq2seq model using beam search decoding
